test_Seq2SeqLMBatch_from_pb: test that Seq2SeqLMBatch.from_pb correctly creates a batch from a protobuf request with input tokenization
test_Seq2SeqLMBatch_concatenate: test that Seq2SeqLMBatch.concatenate merges two batches and preserves past key values and hidden states
test_Seq2SeqLM_generate_token: test that Seq2SeqLM.generate_token produces a single decoder token and returns the next batch state
test_Seq2SeqLM_generate_token_completion: test that repeated generate_token calls complete a full seq2seq generation loop until the batch is exhausted
test that generate_token handles multiple requests with different max token limits and filters completed requests
